summary: Configures a viewport rectangle from top a3, left a2, right a4 and bottom a5: stores the four bounds into this, computes the center X ((left+right)>>1) and center Y ((top+bottom)>>1), precomputes the reciprocal half-width 1.0/((right-left)*0.5) and reciprocal half-height 1.0/((bottom-top)*0.5) for projection scaling, and returns the right-minus-left width difference.

operations.description: Store the right bound a4 into the viewport field at this+0xC (dword index 3).
Compute result = a4 - a2, the width of the viewport in pixels.
Store center X as (left + right) >> 1 into this+0x10 (dword index 4).
Store the bottom bound a5 into this+0x4 (dword index 1).
Store the top bound a3 into this+0x0 (dword index 0).
Store the left bound a2 into this+0x8 (dword index 2).
Store center Y as (top + bottom) >> 1 into this+0x14 (dword index 5).
Store the reciprocal half-width 1.0 / ((right - left) * 0.5) into this+0x18 (float index 6).
Store the reciprocal half-height 1.0 / ((bottom - top) * 0.5) into this+0x1C (float index 7).
Return result = a4 - a2, the viewport width difference.
